name: Dev-via-test re-plan Lisa / CBG failed → stamp agent.run.outcome=failed (lineage anchor)
description:
ADR-053 Phase 4a′ — dev-via-test run-failed mapping, anchor branch 2 of 2 (the run-entity-descended roles). Fires when a RE-PLAN Lisa (dev-via-test-plan spawned from the run entity by rule 02d) or CBG (reviewer-dev-via-test, the chain-end gate spawned via rule 06) terminates with an involuntary failure (agent.loop.outcome in [failed, truncated]). Stamps agent.run.outcome=failed on the RUN entity so agent-run/04 transitions executing→failed; a failed re-plan Lisa or CBG has no in-arc recovery and would otherwise hang the run `executing`.

ANCHOR (lineage.run-loop-entity-id, length_gt 0): re-plan Lisa carries lineage.run-loop-entity-id=$entity.id=chain.execution (threaded by rule 02d) but NOT agent.run.entity_id; CBG carries lineage.run-loop-entity-id (threaded by rule 06). This mirrors dev-via-test/07a's success-stamp anchor. The length_gt 0 fence makes this mutually exclusive with the first-pass-Lisa branch (rule 09, length_eq 0) and ensures the stamp subject resolves (C1 garbage-literal-subject defense).

Companion to dev-via-test/08-loop-failed-pause (operator chain.paused.marker, untouched). dev-via-test-execute (Ralph) stays EXCLUDED — Ralph loop-failure routes to coordinator→ask_user; the run stays executing.
